# Da Gino Il Bonaparte

> A fine-dining seafood restaurant in Milan blending Mediterranean traditions with innovative Italian cuisine in Napoleon-themed dining spaces.

Da Gino Il Bonaparte is a prestigious seafood restaurant located in Milan specializing in fresh fish dishes, Mediterranean cuisine, and Italian culinary traditions. The restaurant offers both traditional fine-dining experiences and private event spaces, with a distinctive Napoleon-inspired aesthetic throughout its dining rooms.
